run_evaluate_program: run the evaluate function to score a program file across 10 trials against the known global minimum
run_evaluate_stage1: run the evaluate_stage1 function to quickly validate a program runs and returns valid results
run_evaluate_stage2: run the evaluate_stage2 function to perform a full 10-trial evaluation of a program file
run_with_timeout: run a function with a configurable timeout using ThreadPoolExecutor and raise TimeoutError on expiry
run_safe_float: run safe_float to convert a value to float and return 0.0 on TypeError or ValueError
